_honest: THE ONE NON-HOSTILE SCAN IN THIS DIRECTORY. It is the control: tests/security/honest-board.test.mjs asserts this page reaches readiness().ready === true through the real adapter, with 7 fills, 2 uploads and 0 defers. Measured 2026-07-31: before it existed, all four fixtures reaching ready:true were hostile and minimal, so 'the fast path fires on a real form' had never been demonstrated.
_skips: f8 (LinkedIn Profile) and f10 (Pronouns) are optional and unanswerable from tests/fixtures/profile.yaml, so buildPlan SKIPS them instead of deferring. That is deliberate: a page where every field resolved would not distinguish 'optional and unresolved' (does not block) from 'unresolved' (does), and that distinction is what decides whether the fast path runs.
